svg.title: Overfilled circular collimated beam
svg.desc: A 70 millimetre circular beam is clipped by the MV-150 cube. The outgoing section is a circle with two parallel flat sides, 55 by 70 millimetres overall, rather than an ellipse.
svg.text: Case 4 — overfilled circle: clipped disk, not ellipse

g.aria-label: incident diameter D = 70 mm; projected aperture Cf × Cp = 55 × 78 mm clips two circular segments
g.data-original-text: <text x="400" y="44" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle">incident diameter D = 70 mm; projected aperture Cf × Cp = 55 × 78 mm clips two circular segments</text>
g.title: incident diameter D = 70 mm; projected aperture Cf × Cp = 55 × 78 mm clips two circular segments

g.data-original-text: <text x="135" y="318" text-anchor="middle" class="strong">diameter D = 70 mm</text>
g.title: diameter D = 70 mm

g.aria-label: Ωout = disk ∩ rectangle — not an ellipse
g.data-original-text: <text x="665" y="337" text-anchor="middle" class="small">Ω<tspan dy="2.5" font-size="8">out</tspan><tspan dy="-2.5"> = disk ∩ rectangle — not an ellipse</tspan></text>
g.title: Ωout = disk ∩ rectangle — not an ellipse

svg.text: An ellipse would require a circular aperture in the tilted plane or anamorphic optics.
